parole.testo: From Northern Kurdish gule – equalling Central Kurdish گولە (gule), Persian گوله (gôla), کله (kola), گوی (gôy), گلوله (golula), Urdu گولی (golī) / Hindi गोली (golī), all meaning more or less small balls or bullets, from the tentative Proto-Indo-European root *gew- (“to curve; ball”).
